title: MICROSOFT JUST DROPPED THIS! Fokker F27 + HUGE Free City Update
description:
Welcome to a massive day for Microsoft Flight Simulator (MSFS). Live from the show floor at FSWeekend 2026 in Lelystad, we are diving deep into two of the most anticipated releases for European flight simmers.

First, we explore City Update 4: Benelux. This free update brings high-fidelity TIN (Triangulated Irregular Network) surface modeling to 10 major areas of interest. Whether you are flying over the Port of Antwerp, the canals of Amsterdam, or the modern skyline of Rotterdam, the level of detail in the Netherlands and Belgium is now unmatched.

The star of the show is Local Legend 12: The Fokker F27 Friendship. Developed by iniBuilds, this high-wing legendary aircraft features the unmistakable sound of Rolls-Royce Dart engines. In this review, we look at the iniBuilds EFB, the flight model refined for MSFS 2024, and the various liveries including passenger and cargo variants.

👇 JOIN THE LIVE STREAM TOMORROW!
We are flying the F27 through the new Benelux scenery at 8:00 PM CET.
Don't forget to SUBSCRIBE and hit the notification bell so you don't miss the takeoff!
